description.value: Grape Escapes is Penticton's #1-rated wine tour company (TripAdvisor Hall of Fame inductee), operating since 2011 and guiding guests through the South Okanagan's celebrated wine regions including Naramata, Okanagan Falls, Summerland, Oliver/Osoyoos, and the Similkameen Valley. Tours include door-to-door pickup and drop-off from any Penticton address, visits to handpicked wineries, and a catered gourmet picnic lunch with vegan and gluten-free options. For touring cyclists staying in or passing through Penticton, this is a way to explore the wine country without riding the full routes.

address.value: 345 Wade Avenue East, Penticton, BC V2A 1S8
